description: Bulk sibling of FreshnessPolicyComponent -- one config block declares freshness policies for many assets at once, grouped by cadence tier, instead of one component instance per asset.

outputs.description: One freshness AssetCheckResult per asset across every declared group.

groups.description: List of {name, policy_type, asset_keys, ...policy fields}. Same policy_type/field shape as FreshnessPolicyComponent (time_window: fail_window_hours; cron: deadline_cron + lower_bound_delta_hours + optional timezone), applied to every asset_key in the group's list.
